title: Schedule list scrolling
lede: The compact event rows and avatar groups stay in place. Reader input now takes priority over unfinished automatic positioning.

sections.heading: After-only evidence
sections.note: Authenticated local Admin preview, existing isolated test database; Chromium at 1440 × 1000, light appearance, reduced motion. Captures were not made against a frozen clock and data snapshot, so no matched visual comparison is claimed.

changes.h: Delayed loading yields to the reader
changes.was: Wheel input during loading was followed by a Today jump to offset 5,933.
changes.now: The identical delayed-load scenario made no automatic Today scroll.

changes.was: Pending restoration remained active after input and could pull the page down when its height changed.
changes.now: After wheel input, offset 29,787 remained 29,787 when another 500 px of content arrived.

changes.was: A modified event click froze position recording; queued writes could outlive the list.
changes.now: Modified-click recording matches offset 6,145. Ordinary reload and Back both restore offset 6,633 exactly. Crew expansion/collapse and tablet overflow checks pass.

verification: TypeScript, scoped ESLint and diff checks pass.
Authenticated isolated browser replay: no page exceptions; reduced-motion Today uses instant positioning.
Application build (npm run build:app), docs verification and final diff check pass.
notes: After-only capture: after-interactions.png. Replay evidence: interactions.json and return-navigation.json.
No API/native changes, assignment mutations, deployment, commit or push in this scrolling slice.
